steps.output:
[doc-09#c0] The Halvard Ridge Seismic Array was installed in 1990 along the spine of Halvard Ridge. It forms part of a wider regional network monitoring the Kessner Fault.

[doc-09#c2] The array consists of 18 seismometers spaced at 400 metre intervals. The largest event it has recorded on the Kessner Fault had a magnitude of 5.6.

[doc-01#c1] The station's principal research programme is tidal acoustics. Its seabed hydrophone array, installed in stages between 1978 and 1984, records low-frequency signals across the Hallen Trench.

[doc-01#c2] The hydrophone array comprises 62 individual elements. Vellmar overwinters a crew of 14, the largest winter complement anywhere in the archipelago.
